intent: Turn already approved R1-first/B2 research-first policy into specific conditional human decisions without treating drafting as validation

decisions.subject: B research construct
decisions.reason: A05 aims to compare how people think about life choices; measuring SDT psychological need satisfaction would change the question and should be a separate study
neededEvidence: Construct domain: whose preferences, which decisions, when/no others involved
Independent content validity review and target-population comprehension
Assess social desirability, dual high/low responding and 12-item burden
Research authorization G1 and applicable D42 before collecting real answers
productionRules: No B2_P scores or diagnostic assignment in R1
No mapping B2 to old B1 bipolar bit

decisions.subject: A operating meaning
counterexamples: Stable residence while exploring new fields
Cannot move but seeks changes in routines
neededEvidence: Operational domain selection
6-item relevance and nonredundancy check
Opportunity constraint controls
Distinctiveness from D

decisions.subject: C operating meaning
counterexamples: Enjoys today while planning for future
Priorities vary under unequal costs and gains
neededEvidence: Specify time horizon and equal effort assumptions
Control magnitude/probability of benefits
Distinguish auxiliary E and current obligations
Nonredundant C01,C02,C05

decisions.subject: D operating meaning
counterexamples: Broad interests, deep specialization in one
neededEvidence: Define interest domains and response frame
Avoid travel/resource opportunity confounds
Distinguish A change orientation and D02/D03 duplication

decisions.subject: R1 draft IDs and measured taxonomy migration
conditions: Keep current draft 16 characters/136 pairs as archive and manual editorial materials
Do not assign real people types from new B2 answers
Do not change legacy question/scoring/type/content version semantics

Do not treat mathematical 16/32/8 patterns as validated personality types
S5/S7 must validate confusion risk before publication

Owner decision that manual draft characters are acceptable with explicit limitations
R1-only code QA and UX nonmisinterpretation review

neededEvidence: Science reviewer role assigned + signed evidence
Editorial reviewer role assigned + signed evidence
